.aiwg/architecture/package-architecture..title: Package Architecture
.aiwg/architecture/package-architecture..summary: fortemi-react ships three published npm packages plus a private demo app. They form a strict layering: `@fortemi/core` is the base and depends on nothing in the workspace; `@fortemi/graph` builds on core (projection helpers plus a `GraphController`); `@fortemi/react` binds both to React. The dependencies form a linear chain with no cycles — `@electric-sql/pglite ← @fortemi/core ← @fortemi/graph ← @fortemi/react`
